## Abstract

The **poster conference**: groups present and pitch their country/region-analysis posters
(max. 5 minutes per student) and discuss them with the class. See the
[examination page](examination.qmd) for the poster requirements and assessment criteria.

::: {.callout-important}
## Submission deadline: 13 December 2026, 23:59 CET

Upload the digital copy of your poster to
[Moodle](https://elearning.uni-flensburg.de/moodle/course/view.php?id=17919) by then, and
bring a printed copy to the conference.
:::
